passage.title: Teacher-written persuasive article for the Year 8 end-of-year test (TGA)
paras: We carry the world's libraries in our pockets, yet many of us have never felt so distracted. The average teenager checks a phone dozens of times a day; each glance is small, but together they add up to hours. Is this freedom? Or have we simply swapped one master for another? I am not asking anyone to throw their phone into the sea. I am asking for something harder: one hour a day, every day, when the screen is dark and the mind is ours again. Try it for a week. You may find that the world can wait, and that you were the one who needed you.
